title: Settings
resetAction: Restore the app to its original defaults

resetDescription:
This will:

- Remove saved connections and local authorization credentials
- Restore language, appearance, hints, and default cloud locations
- Clear the current rule chain

It will not delete real files or undo completed renames.
readFailed: Could not load app settings. Using default preferences: {{message}}
languageSaveFailed: Could not save the language. The change was reverted: {{message}}
themeSaveFailed: Could not save the appearance. The change was reverted: {{message}}
resetUnknown: Verify items with unknown outcomes and end the current task first.
resetBusy: Wait for the rename operation to finish before resetting.
resetSaving: A connection is being saved. Try again shortly.
